title: World-In-World: World Models in a Closed-Loop World

layout.note: A gradient question banner on top; a middle band with three zones (light-blue models, a brown-outlined platform box with a robot, light-purple task cards) joined by four horizontal block arrows; a dark gradient answer banner at the bottom holding a leaderboard tile and three schematic plots on a translucent grey panel.

lesson: Frame a benchmark teaser with a question banner on top and an answer banner below; in between put the platform box with a policy icon whose arrows join model logos on one side to task cards on the other, then close with a leaderboard tile and tick-less schematic plots that reuse the logos as markers.
